name: Golden Circle in a day
description_md:
The Golden Circle in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in IS. This path covers a distance of 8.2 km and requires about 5.3 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is classified as a waymarked hiking route. It is situated in the country of IS.
